description: Selected Azure service migration tasks for ContosoUniversity, generated from assessment report report-20260925090428. Alternative storage and SQL targets are retained for an explicit pre-execution choice; only one task in each alternative pair is to be executed.

tasks.description: Migrate selected static and uploaded content from the local file system to Azure Blob Storage. Addresses issues: Static content detected. [kbId: local-file-to-azure-blob-storage]
tasks.reason: The assessment and current project confirm locally served Content, Scripts, and uploaded teaching-material images that are not independently scalable.
tasks.requirements: Preserve static-content delivery and course teaching-material upload, replacement, display, and deletion behavior. Target Azure Blob Storage with managed identity. This is mutually exclusive with task 002 for the same workload; execute only the authoritative storage target chosen before migration.

tasks.description: Migrate selected local-file workloads to Azure File Storage. Addresses issues: Static content detected. [kbId: local-file-to-azure-file-storage]
tasks.reason: The selected solution provides a file-compatible Azure target for confirmed local static and uploaded content.
tasks.requirements: Preserve file-path-dependent static-content and course teaching-material behavior while targeting Azure File Storage with managed identity. This is mutually exclusive with task 001 for the same workload; skip this task when Blob Storage is authoritative.

tasks.description: Migrate SQL Server connectivity to managed-identity-based Azure SQL Database. Addresses issues: SQL database connection detected. [kbId: local-sql-server-to-azure-sql-db]
tasks.reason: The application currently uses a LocalDB SQL Server connection with integrated security from Web.config.
tasks.requirements: Preserve Entity Framework data access, schema, initialization, and application behavior while targeting Azure SQL Database and removing dependence on Windows-integrated database credentials. This is mutually exclusive with task 004; execute only the authoritative SQL target chosen before migration.

tasks.description: Migrate SQL Server connectivity to managed-identity-based Azure SQL Managed Instance. Addresses issues: SQL database connection detected. [kbId: local-sql-server-to-azure-sql-mi]
tasks.reason: The selected alternative retains SQL Server compatibility while moving the confirmed database dependency to an Azure-managed service.
tasks.requirements: Preserve Entity Framework data access, schema, initialization, and application behavior while targeting Azure SQL Managed Instance and removing dependence on Windows-integrated database credentials. This is mutually exclusive with task 003; skip this task when Azure SQL Database is authoritative.

tasks.description: Migrate Windows AD authentication to Microsoft Entra ID. Addresses issues: Windows authentication detected. [kbId: windows-ad-to-azure-ad]
tasks.reason: The current project enables Windows authentication, which the assessment identifies as incompatible with common Azure hosting targets.
tasks.requirements: Replace the confirmed Windows-authentication dependency with Microsoft Entra ID while preserving authenticated user access, authorization expectations, and user identity availability to notification workflows.

tasks.description: Move plaintext credentials to Azure Key Vault protected by managed identity. Addresses issues: Connection strings without configuration builders detected. [kbId: plaintext-credential-to-azure-keyvault]
tasks.reason: Web.config contains a directly configured database connection and the assessment confirms configuration without secure builders.
tasks.requirements: Remove plaintext secret material from application configuration, retrieve required secrets from Azure Key Vault using managed identity, and preserve the configuration behavior expected by database and messaging integrations.

tasks.description: Modernize local and network file-system management for Azure compatibility. Addresses issues: Local or network IO operations detected. [kbId: file-system-management-prompt]
tasks.reason: CoursesController directly maps server paths and creates, writes, replaces, and deletes local files.
tasks.requirements: Make confirmed course teaching-material file operations cloud-compatible while preserving validation, upload, replacement, display, and deletion semantics. Align with the authoritative storage target selected from tasks 001 and 002; do not introduce an additional storage target.

tasks.description: Migrate MSMQ notification messaging to Azure Service Bus. Addresses issues: MSMQ usage is detected. [kbId: msmq-to-azure-servicebus]
tasks.reason: NotificationService creates, secures, sends to, and receives from a local MSMQ queue that is not supported by the selected Azure migration direction.
tasks.requirements: Replace MSMQ notification send and receive behavior with Azure Service Bus using managed identity. Preserve notification payloads, labels, timeout/no-message behavior, failure isolation, and existing application workflows.

tasks.description: Scan project dependencies for known CVEs and remediate identified vulnerabilities after all selected transformations.
tasks.reason: Every modernization plan requires a final dependency security and CVE remediation task.
tasks.requirements: Scan all production dependencies and upgrade vulnerable dependencies to the minimum patched version. Document any required major-version upgrade and its breaking-change risk. Verify that the project builds and all existing tests pass after remediation.
